name: Craftsman's Writ: Swift Boots
summary: A customer requests one pair of Swift Boots through a transferable writ. You need the writ to complete the delivery and payment.

sections.title: A Customer's Request
sections.body: A faded note asks you to provide one pair of Swift Boots. It also mentions a delivery location and payment. The writ can be transferred, but you need it in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one pair of Swift Boots.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the boots?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ with you to complete the transaction.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ says it can be transferred.
The note mentions payment, but gives no amount.
